== Description ==

[[Barry Alperstein]] (left, olive MORDOR graphic tee, beard, looking at cards) and [[Greg Shaw]] (right, red “TAKE OCTOBER” hoodie, beard, looking at cards) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
